definitions.gloss: to divide up; to distribute; to allocate
definitions.explanation: to split something into portions and assign them to different places, people, or categories

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振|ふ}り{分|わ}けた。
examples.english: I distributed the work among the team.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{各|かく}{部署|ぶしょ}→各部署：29114_kakubusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振|ふ}り{分|わ}ける。
examples.english: We allocate the budget to each department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振|ふ}り{分|わ}けて⟦{持|も}った→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I divided the luggage between bags on each side.
